<!-- pr-reviewer: 2d7a638f55b2aa2c673a8fee16361464abb6edec -->
Full independent review of head 2d7a638f5. It also covers the hand resolution of the refresh (merge of main). Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge. Two follow-ups are listed below. Neither one blocks.

## What looks good
- The change is small and in the right place. `machining3d::open_sides` takes the stock outline, and the band grows from (silhouette union stock). `keep_out` is still subtracted after the growth (`crates/motion/src/machining3d/open_side.rs`). So the neighbour law and the keep law still bound the region. The solid law still judges the cut.
- Degenerate input is handled. Zero or non-finite growth returns the silhouette. An empty stock or no stock gives the #1749 result. A stock equal to the silhouette adds nothing. A smaller stock is absorbed by the union. No new unwrap, expect or panic.
- The tilted branch of `open_footprint` (`crates/app/src/operation/open_side.rs`) now refuses by name (`TILTED_OPEN_SIDE`) and is pinned by a lib unit test. No 3D pocket kind carries a tilt, so a project cannot hold a tilted 3D Pocket. An old project cannot load into a silent change. `no_3d_pocket_kind_carries_a_tilt` pins this premise.
- The claims in the body are pinned. `stock_far_past_the_silhouette_is_cleared_to_the_stock_outline` checks the floor at the stock edge and on a ring at 28 mm. It also checks no gouge and 0 verify warnings. This confirms the refresh agent's report (far stock generates Ok, 0 warnings). The Multi-Axis Rough twin is pinned in `operations.rs`.
- The change to `level_links::a_helix_under_the_bore_floor_is_never_silent` keeps its bore and verify asserts. It now asserts a 5 mm disc distance from the part facets for every move below Z 0. This is the right, stricter assert.
- Hand resolution is correct. I read `git show --remerge-diff 2d7a638f5`. The only conflict was in `pocket3d_open_side.rs`, where both sides added tests at one place. All tests are kept, with the closing brace fixed. The file has 7 tests, and all pass.
- Placement, Gate maps, provenance lines and the decision file format are right. The PR body has a `Changelog:` line. There is no edit to `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, no process file and no snapshot PNG. `generate.rs` is 3657 lines (already over 400). The PR changes 3 lines net there.

## Results merged with main (local, head merges cleanly with origin/main 7c514c874; no runner used)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| app `pocket3d_open_side` | 7 passed |
| app `shared_face_bodies` | 5 passed, 1 ignored (as on main) |
| app `keep_law` | 8 passed |
| app `neighbour_law` | 6 passed |
| app `level_links` | 7 passed |
| motion `pocket_refusal` | 3 passed |
| motion `machining3d` | 23 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the ignored heavy lanes, the batch tier, the ui suites.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Fixture or clamp in the newly cleared stock margin: no test builds one. The cutter now enters this margin, which main left uncut. The fixture law of verify (`mesh_steel` in `generate.rs`) judges it, so a hit is warned. It is not refused at generation. The body says this is untested. I suggest a follow-up issue with a pinning test (`P7`). It is not a blocker: the margin was never reached before, the user sets the stock, and verify still judges the path.
2. The 3D Pocket ladder ignores shank and holder. This is already tracked in #1844 and is not made worse here.
3. The tilt refusal is in the generator only. It cannot be reached today, because no kind has a tilt. If a kind gains a tilt, the command creation must also check it.
4. Output change: whole-model 3D Pocket runs on a generous stock now cut more. The ignored `pocket3d_hsm` move counts and `stock_engine_agreement` may need a look at the next release tier.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
